_doc: Render colours and heights for two buildings next to Spinnerij De Stoop on the Spinnerijkaai, read by pipeline/src/scene.ts (one part per GRB footprint via 'oidn'). Look (Google Street View from the Groeningekaai, look-up only; Tom's feedback 2026-11-14): GRB 1734208 on the quay is a low yellow (buff) brick building with a columned front and a flat roof (painted before as slate roofs on red brick); GRB 4600463 is a modern white apartment block of 5-6 storeys with balconies and solar panels on a flat roof (painted before as an orange tiled roof on buff walls).
